phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F2 Phase A1 — Deposit Submatrix Coverage Audit
meaning: Deposits only; not total F2 currency and deposits

official_definition.rule: Deposits F22/F29 are standardised non-negotiable contracts offered by deposit-taking corporations and, in some cases, central government as debtors; non-resident institutional units may also be deposit debtors.
official_definition.implication_for_rmd: H and C are not deposit-issuing sectors in the canonical F2M holder-by-issuer matrix and are structural NOT_APPLICABLE issuer columns, not missing observations.

canonical_orientation.domestic_holder_to_domestic_issuer: issuer-liability QSA W2 series: reference sector = issuer, counterpart sector = holder, accounting entry = L
canonical_orientation.rest_of_world_holder_to_resident_issuer: issuer-liability QSA W1 series with counterpart sector S1
canonical_orientation.resident_holder_to_rest_of_world_issuer: holder-asset external-sector source; QSA W1 F2M is unavailable in the current audit and must not be inferred from row residuals

parallel_blockers.effect: Total F2 Accounting Spine remains incomplete even if F2M deposits are recovered.
A complete F2M matrix cannot be claimed until an official external-statistics source is reconciled to the missing X issuer column.

preferred_sources: ECB BPS / Balance of Payments and International Investment Position
next_source_gate.reason: External statistics explicitly cover resident claims on non-residents, including Other Investment / Currency and Deposits, but sector mapping and accounting-concept reconciliation must be verified before use.
